audio.strategy: Live additive synthesis of a single piano-like voice. No recorded samples are used.

generatedSources.name: phase1-basic-piano
generatedSources.description: Six inharmonic sine partials, velocity-sensitive lowpass brightness, and an ADSR envelope generated at note-on. This is synthesized audio, not a recording of a piano.

notes: Phase 1 provides one synthesized piano-like voice only.
Panel controls including Master Level are decorative and do not change the audible signal.
Sustain is driven by the Sustain pedal UI, the Space key, and MIDI CC64.
Generated buffers are never described as recordings.
